summary: The fog from lava is much denser when having the Fire Resistance effect active compared to Bedrock Edition
description:
## The Bug:

The fog from lava is much denser in java edition when having the fire resistance effect active compared to bedrock edition.

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Launch the java edition version of the game and join a world.

 - Drink a fire resistance potion and enter a large area of lava.

 - Take note of how dense the lava fog is.

 - Launch the bedrock edition version of the game and join a world.

 - Drink a fire resistance potion and enter a large area of lava.

 - Take note of how dense the lava fog is compared to java edition.

## Observed Behavior:

The fog from lava is much denser in java edition when having the fire resistance effect active compared to bedrock edition.

## Expected Behavior:

The fog from lava in java and bedrock edition when having the fire resistance effect active would have the same density.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition.
2. Join a world.
3. Drink a Fire Resistance potion.
4. Enter a large area of lava.
5. Observe the density of the lava fog.
6. Launch Minecraft Bedrock Edition.
7. Join a world.
8. Drink a Fire Resistance potion.
9. Enter a large area of lava.
10. Compare the lava fog density with Java Edition and observe that it is much denser in Java Edition.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.1, 20w29a, 20w30a, 1.16.2 Pre-release 1, 1.16.2 Pre-release 2, 1.16.2 Pre-release 3, 1.16.2 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.2 Release Candidate 2, 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.4, 20w45a, 20w46a, 20w48a, 20w49a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05a, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w18a, 1.17 Pre-release 1, 1.17, 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 21w40a, 21w41a, 21w43a, 1.18, 1.18.1 Release Candidate 2, 1.18.1, 1.18.2 Pre-release 2, 1.18.2, 22w17a, 1.19, 1.19.2, 22w43a, 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 1.20, 1.20.1 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: With the **Fire Resistance** effect active, entering lava in **Java Edition** produces substantially denser lava fog, resulting in shorter underwater visibility through the lava. Under the same conditions in **Bedrock Edition**, the lava fog is noticeably less dense and visibility is greater. The difference occurs while the player is affected by Fire Resistance and is limited to the rendering density of lava fog.
Expected Behavior: When the player has the Fire Resistance effect while submerged in lava, the lava fog should have the same density in Java Edition as in Bedrock Edition. The effect should not cause Java Edition to display significantly denser fog, and visibility through lava should remain consistent between both editions under otherwise equivalent conditions.
